scanner.subtitle: Amsa tambayoyi game da manhajar ka. Sami makin hadari nan take tare da sassan da suka shafa da bayani a harshe mai sauƙi.
scanner.appName.label: Me kake ginawa?
scanner.explanation.low: "{{appName}}" yana da ƙaramin hadarin bin doka a ƙarƙashin NDP Act 2023 da GAID 2025. Kariya ta asali tana nan. Ci gaba da lura da ayyukan bayananka.
scanner.explanation.medium: "{{appName}}" yana da matsakaicin hadarin bin doka. Wurare da yawa suna buƙatar kulawa don guje wa yiwuwar matakin tilastawa NDPC.
scanner.explanation.high: "{{appName}}" yana da manyan hadarurrukan bin doka a ƙarƙashin NDP Act. Idan ba a gyara ba, za ka iya fuskantar tara har ₦10M ko 2% na kudaden shiga na shekara.
scanner.explanation.critical: "{{appName}}" yana cikin babban hadari! An gano abubuwa masu yawa masu hadari a ƙarƙashin NDP Act 2023. Ana buƙatar matakin gaggawa don guje wa hukunci mai tsanani na NDPC.

problem.story.part1: Wani mai ƙirƙira a Najeriya ya ƙaddamar da manhajar lafiya.
problem.story.part2: Masu amfani suna son ta — 5,000 sun yi rajista a mako na farko. Bayan makonni biyu, NDPC ta aika da sanarwar tilastawa.
problem.fine.part2: — ko 2% na kudaden shiga na shekara, wanda ya fi girma. Babu manufar sirri. Babu tsarin yarda. Babu binciken bayanai.
problem.solution: RegTrack na hana wannan. Cikin mintuna, ba watanni ba.
solution.subtitle: RegTrack yana ba ku damar fahimtar bin doka nan take ta hanyar cikakken tsarin NDP Act da GAID 2025.

solution.finder.description: Bincika cikakken tsarin NDP Act da GAID 2025 ta kalma. Nemo ainihin sashen da ya shafi yanayinka tare da taƙaitaccen bayani.

checklist.items.rem-privacy-policy.title: Buga Manufar Sirri
checklist.items.rem-privacy-policy.descr: Manhajar ka tana tattara bayanan sirri amma ba ta da manufar sirri. Sashe na 27 na NDP Act yana buƙatar bayani mai gaskiya game da sarrafa bayanai.
checklist.items.rem-consent.title: Ƙaddamar da Tsarin Yarda
checklist.items.rem-consent.description: Samu yarda bayyananniya kafin tattara bayanan sirri kamar yadda Sashe na 26 na NDP Act ya buƙata.
checklist.items.rem-children.title: Kariyar Bayanan Yara
checklist.items.rem-children.description: Ƙaddamar da tabbatar da shekaru da yardar iyaye ga masu amfani da ba su kai shekara 18 ba kamar yadda Sashe na 31 na NDP Act ya buƙata.
checklist.items.rem-appoint-dpo.title: Nada Jami'in Kare Bayanai
checklist.items.rem-appoint-dpo.descript: Nada DPO kamar yadda ake buƙata don ayyukan sarrafawa a ƙarƙashin Sashe na 32 na NDP Act.
checklist.items.rem-file-audit.title: Shigar da Rahoton Binciken Bin Doka
checklist.items.rem-file-audit.descripti: Ƙaddamar da shigar da CAR na shekara ga NDPC kafin 31 ga Maris kamar yadda GAID 2025 ya buƙata.
checklist.items.rem-register-ndpc.title: Yi Rajista da NDPC
checklist.items.rem-register-ndpc.descri: Yi rajista a matsayin mai sarrafa bayanai mai muhimmanci a ƙarƙashin Sashe na 44 na NDP Act.
checklist.items.rem-dpia.title: Gudanar da Kimanta Tasirin Kare Bayanai
checklist.items.rem-dpia.description: Gudanar da DPIA don ayyukan sarrafawa masu haɗari kamar yadda Sashe na 28 na NDP Act ya buƙata.
checklist.items.rem-cross-border.title: Kariyar Canja Sheƙa ta Ƙetare
checklist.items.rem-cross-border.descrip: Tabbatar da isasshen kariya ga canja sheƙar bayanai na ƙasa da ƙasa kamar yadda Sassan 41-43 na NDP Act suka buƙata.
checklist.items.rem-third-party.title: Yarjejeniyar Sarrafa Bayanai ta Ƙungiya ta Uku
checklist.items.rem-third-party.descript: Ƙaddamar da yarjejeniyar sarrafa bayanai a rubuce tare da duk masu siyarwa da masu ba da sabis.
checklist.items.rem-agf-coord.title: Haɗin Kai da Babban Lauyan Tarayya
checklist.items.rem-agf-coord.descriptio: Haɗa kai da ofishin AGF don amincewar canja sheƙa ta ƙetare kamar yadda ake buƙata.
checklist.items.rem-cookie-consent.title: Ƙaddamar da Yardar Kuki
checklist.items.rem-cookie-consent.descr: Ƙaddamar da banner ɗin yardar kuki don bin diddigin yanar gizo da nazari.
footer.tagline: Haɗa ƙirƙira da ƙa'idojin Najeriya. Bin NDP Act & GAID 2025 ta AI ga masu gina makomar Afirka.
footer.whyBuilt.title: Me Ya Sa Muka Gina Wannan don Najeriya
footer.whyBuilt.description: An gina shi a Abuja daga masu ƙirƙira 'yan Najeriya, don ƙa'idojin Najeriya. Mun yi imani kowane mai farawa a Najeriya ya cancanci ƙaddamarwa da tabbaci — sanin cewa ayyukan bayanansu suna kare masu amfani da kasuwancinsu. RegTrack ta wanzu saboda bin ƙa'ida bai kamata ya zama shamaki ga ƙirƙira a cikin mafi girman yanayin fasaha na Afirka ba. Ana amfani da NDP Act 2023, Tsarin Aiwatar da NDPR, da GAID 2025.
